name: uat-dry-c-piroplasmadb
turns: Cytauxzoon felis Winnie genes with a predicted GPI anchor or a signal peptide.
rationale: The organism row that a text step and the signal peptide step both answer is not held to the records, so no organism gap stands while every sampled record is Cytauxzoon felis strain Winnie; the GPI anchor stand-in row holds no gap on records judged unclear. A card label is never a requirement, so no facts part names 'Specify an alternative evidence type' as a gap.

provenance.curatorNote: One message naming a GPI anchor or a signal peptide; no search states the anchor, so the card offers a stand-in and the accepted stand-in joins the signal peptide under UNION with the anchor requirement retired. The stand-in's search is the card's pick, so the case pins the operator and not the tree.

picks: Use a text search for GPI anchor in the gene product descriptions as the stand-in and keep it OR with the signal peptide
